ctaHeading: Your Mill Park plumber is one call away.
aboutText: For over 20 years, Plumbjak has provided the highest quality plumbing services to homes and businesses across Mill Park, Eltham, and Mernda. We understand costs matter, so we listen to your needs and offer customised, cost-effective solutions at very competitive rates. Our experienced, licensed, and insured master plumbers deliver exceptional workmanship for every job.
servicesText: From urgent burst pipes to planned renovations, our highly trained team offers reliable and efficient plumbing. We provide specialised services for residential, commercial, and industrial needs across Melbourne's north.

services.title: Emergency & Blocked Drains
services.desc: 24-hour reliable service for burst pipes, blocked drains, and urgent clogs to restore your flow fast.

services.title: Hot Water Systems
services.desc: Expert repair, replacement, and installation for all hot water system makes and models to keep you warm.

services.title: General & Tap Repairs
services.desc: Efficient solutions for leaky taps, running toilets, and all general plumbing maintenance needs.

services.title: Roofing, Gutters & Leaks
services.desc: Specialised repair for water leaks, gutters, and roofing issues to protect your home from the top down.

services.title: Gas & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Licensed gas fitting, kitchen project plumbing, and appliance installation for safe, reliable operation.

services.title: Commercial & Renovations
services.desc: Grease traps, industrial plumbing, and full bathroom or kitchen renovation projects handled professionally.
